title: Backward Scan Step
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Boolean Turing machine, let $a,R$ be natural numbers, let $B$ be a base controller configuration, and let $u,g$ be integers. Suppose the base guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$. One schedule step from the backward phase with unary-counter head at $u$ and guide head at $g$ enters the return-to-center phase and moves the guide head to $g+1$ if $g=-R-1$; otherwise it stays in the backward phase and moves the guide head to $g-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $W$ is a finite Boolean Turing machine
The base guide tape equals the fixed guide of radius $R$
replaced:
Suppose the base's guide tape is the fixed guide of radius $R$.  From the backward
phase with guide head at $g$, one step of the schedule controller turns into the
return-to-center phase and moves the guide head right exactly when $g = -R - 1$, and
otherwise stays in the backward phase and moves the guide head left.
